title: Scared of the dark.
lines: During the day she is very brave.
She climbs right to the top of the climbing frame.
She jumps from the highest step of the slide.
But in the evening, when the light goes out, Mila isn't so brave.
Then she's scared of the dark.
One evening Daddy reads her a story.
Mila is in bed with her cuddly rabbit Flos.
Then Daddy gives her a kiss.
Mila pulls the blanket up to her nose.
In the corner there's something big.
A strange sound, at the window.
There's a monster in the corner!
And there's something at the window!
With her dressing gown and her scarf on it.
The long arms are your dressing gown.
Then Daddy goes to the window.
A branch touches the window when the wind blows.
But she's still a bit scared.
Daddy sits down on the edge of the bed.
You know, Mila, he says, in the dark everything looks different.
Your eyes can't see very well.
And then your head makes something up.
A coat stand becomes a monster.
A branch becomes a scary sound.
But everything is exactly the same as in the daytime.
I have an idea, says Daddy.
He goes downstairs and comes back with a torch.
This is your monster-finding torch, says Daddy.
If you see something in the dark, shine it on it.
Then you'll see straight away what it really is.
Daddy turns off the light again.
She shines it into the corner.
She shines it at the window.
She shines it under the bed.
Only a sock and a puzzle piece.
She shines it at the ceiling.
There she sees the glow-in-the-dark stars that Mummy stuck up there.
Your room is pretty in the dark too, says Daddy.
In the daytime you can't see the stars.
Then Daddy does one more thing.
He puts a little night light in the socket.
It gives a soft, orange light.
Like a little sun that's sleeping.
And I'll leave the door open a crack.
Flos is a bit scared too, she says.
Then you must hold Flos tight, says Daddy.
Daddy gives her one more kiss.
She looks at the little stars on the ceiling.
She hears Mummy and Daddy talking downstairs.
She hears the branch against the window.
That's the tree, she whispers to Flos.
She shines her torch into the corner one last time.
And then she closes her eyes.
The next morning Mummy comes to wake her up.
I went monster hunting with my torch.
Just a coat stand, a tree and lots and lots of stars.
How brave you are, she says.
